alert.sourceClass: exact Google Search Console transactional alert
alert.issueType: Image size smaller than recommended size

conclusion.summary: Align HCM has active HubSpot-generated AMP variants across at least 63 sitemap-listed blog pages. The exact alert is a non-critical image-size recommendation, not a critical AMP validity failure. Public readback cannot identify the exact affected URL because the alert omitted examples and the authenticated Search Console report was not opened.
conclusion.likelyRemediationClass: HubSpot blog featured-image or Article structured-data image sizing
conclusion.recommendedNextStep: Use the authorized Search Console property to capture the exact example URL, then inspect that HubSpot post's featured or structured-data image and replace it with a correctly cropped source at least 1200 pixels wide before requesting validation. Keep any HubSpot edit and validation request approval-gated.

limitations: The transactional alert does not list the affected URL.
The public probe confirms AMP coverage and transport health but cannot reproduce Search Console's private enhancement report.
The host returned HTTP 429 after 30 AMP-variant checks; those responses are treated as probe throttling, not page failures.
No production setting, page, image, Search Console property, or HubSpot content was changed.
